documents.population: International Undergraduate Admission (Spring 2027 application guide), international applicants to undergraduate majors including Computer Science and Engineering
documents.notes: Korea University's Office of International Affairs application guide for the Spring 2027 intake (online application 3-31 August 2026; the guide's 'Key Changes for the 2027 Academic Year' is an application-cycle label, kept here and not as the list's academic year). No Fall 2027 guide was published on 2026-10-19. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): Consent of Collection and Use of Personal Information & Citizenship Statement; parents' passport copies; Family Register / Relationship Certificate (translated and notarized); documents for applicants with Korean ethnicity or special family situations; optional documents (language tests other than English/Korean, national qualifications, prizes); Art & Design portfolio (not relevant to Computer Science). Applicants must also meet a Korean or English language proficiency requirement.

items.quote: 1. Required Documents for All Applicants Documents Notes Copy of Online Application
Documents 1 - 3 must be completed, and be printed from the online application system for submission. Statement of Purpose
Photographs (3x4cm / max. 24KB) must have been taken within the last three months.
Photocopy of the Passport Information (photo) Page of the Applicant and Parent(s)
Authorized language proficiency test score of English or Korean (TOPIK, TOPIK iBT, TOEFL iBT, TOEFL iBT Enhancement, IELTS Academic) within the validity period.
items.condition: language proficiency shown with an English test (TOEFL iBT / IELTS Academic) rather than Korean (TOPIK) or a Korean/English-medium school confirmation; International Studies applicants must submit English

items.quote: Official Transcript of High/Secon dary School Must obtain apostille stamps or consular authentication
2) Official Graduation Certificate of High/Secon dary School
Apostille stamps or Korean consular authentication must be on the original academic documents.
items.notes: Apostille or Korean consular authentication; not required for certificates issued by schools in Korea.

items.quote: All documents must be translated in English or Korean with notarization.
items.condition: family register / relationship documents not in English or Korean (notarized translation)

items.quote: An applicant's admission may be denied or revoked if the required final academic documents and proof of bank balance are not submitted by the designated deadline
items.condition: after admission (proof of bank balance, with the final academic documents)

items.quote: Standardized international admissions qualifications tests (ACT, A-level, AP, IB, SAT, 高考, HKDSE, ATAR, NCEA, STPM, etc.)
